Installation & icon help
  • Chrome / Edge on a computerOpen this site in your regular browser. Choose its address-bar install icon, or find “Install page as app” / “Install this site as an app” in the browser menu.
  • AndroidUse Chrome’s menu → Add to home screen → Install.
  • iPhone / iPadOpen in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen. Keep “Open as Web App” enabled if shown.
  • Mac with SafariOn macOS Sonoma 14 or later, choose File → Add to Dock.

Missing an icon after installing with a Flatpak browser on Linux? Its desktop launcher may point to a sandbox path that does not exist on the host. The browser’s exported icon and launcher path need to agree.

Embedded browsers and some desktop browsers do not offer app installation. If no install option appears, use a regular Chrome or Edge window.

History stays in this browser’s storage. Safari app installs and other profiles may have separate history; export important flights before switching. Offline mode opens recorded flights; fresh speed tests, ISP details and server searches need internet.
